title: Einstein said no to the presidency
the_thought: He thought Zionism should build a home, not a nation like the others.
hook: In 1952, Israel asked Einstein to take the presidency of a new country.

levels.name: The Short
beats: He said no, and people heard a man walking away from the Jewish state. He thought Zionism should build a home, not a nation like the others. For thirty years he had helped build that home across an ocean. Banquets raised money for a university that did not exist yet. Then they offered him the highest chair in the new country. He kept his no and left the sealed envelope on the wooden desk. A university on a hill was his kind of yes. A throne with borders, an army, and a crown was never the yes he wanted. The full story is on this channel.
